data.ranking: Generic foods and dishes together, by a score computed from the data (each result's score and why): every word as a whole word (not only the start of a longer word), the name starting with the words or in USDA order ('Oil, olive'), not naming another food ('banana nectar', 'pomme de terre'), fewer extra words, the record for the food unspecified (NFS, average); raw or as sold before cooked; processed forms (powder, dried, canned, frozen, candied, smoked...), parts (skin), baby foods, brand and restaurant records only when asked for; foods used most in USDA FNDDS 2021-2023 survey recipes (half weight for names in other languages); preferred records; USDA reference records for English names, CIQUAL for other languages. Ties: fewer words, shorter name, id. Then branded products by full-text relevance (bm25).
